        finish (get interval "end")]
    (if (<= start finish)
      {"start" start "end" finish}
      {"start" finish "end" start})))

  "Return true when the next interval is within tolerance."
  [current next tolerance]
  (<= (get next "start")
      (+ (get current "end") tolerance)))
